name: ibis budget Singapore Bugis
short_description: An 84-room 2-star budget hotel on Middle Road, about a 10-minute walk from Bugis MRT, in the Bras Basah-Bugis arts precinct.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Bugis sits at 33 Middle Road in the Bras Basah-Bugis arts and heritage precinct, about a 10-minute walk from Bugis MRT Station and roughly 15 minutes on foot from Parco Bugis Junction. The 84-room economy property -- formerly branded Fragrance Hotel Bugis -- offers compact standard rooms (as small as 129 square feet) with coffee/tea facilities, a flat-screen TV, and paperless check-in, but has no pool, gym, breakfast service, or on-site restaurant. Guest reviews are mixed: many praise the location and helpful, friendly staff, while a vocal set of reviews describe issues with room upkeep and noise insulation. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits, though ALL members can still book member rates.

elite_benefits: ALL - Accor Live Limitless members can book member-exclusive rates
core_facts.elite_notes: This property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits, per its official ALL listing; ALL members can still book member rates here, but a stay earns no points and carries no status benefits.

pros: About a 10-minute walk to Bugis MRT Station, in the Bras Basah-Bugis arts and heritage precinct
15-minute walk to Parco Bugis Junction, Bugis Street, and Suntec City/Marina Square
Paperless check-in and complimentary coffee/tea making facilities in-room
Bus stop directly at the hotel's doorstep
Consistently strong location and service scores in Accor's own guest-rating data
cons: No pool, gym, breakfast service, or on-site restaurant/bar
Rooms run very small (as little as 129 sq ft), and a portion of reviews flag noise insulation and room-upkeep issues
research_highlights: Accor's official ALL page shows a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 495 reviews, with very strong Location (9.7-9.9/10) and Service (9.5-9.8/10) scores against much weaker room-size scores (4.1-6.2/10)
A January 2023 photo blog review confirmed a compact standard twin room with a Sharp TV, work desk, and paperless check-in, plus a short walk to Bugis Junction and two MRT stops from Marina Bay Sands
The hotel is explicitly listed as not participating in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme for points earning or redemption, though member rates remain bookable
research_watchouts: No pool, gym, or on-site dining is listed on the official page, unlike some other ibis budget Singapore properties -- this is a more stripped-down economy format

TripAdvisor includes some sharply negative user reviews (e.g. titled 'Worst Hotel Ever') alongside many positive ones, so guest experience appears more variable than the strong aggregate ALL Rating alone suggests

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Bugis from Bugis MRT station?
faqs.answer: It's about a 10-minute walk to Bugis MRT Station, and roughly 15 minutes on foot to Parco Bugis Junction, Bugis Street, and Suntec City/Marina Square. A bus stop sits directly outside the hotel.

faqs.question: Does ibis budget Singapore Bugis have a pool or breakfast?
faqs.answer: No -- unlike some other ibis budget properties in Singapore, this hotel does not have a pool, gym, breakfast service, or on-site restaurant/bar. Amenities are limited to Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and in-room coffee/tea making facilities.

faqs.question: Can ALL - Accor Live Limitless members earn points at ibis budget Singapore Bugis?
faqs.answer: No -- per the hotel's official ALL listing, this property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits like room upgrades or lounge access. ALL members can still book member-exclusive rates when reserving directly through the ALL - Accor Live Limitless website or app.
